connection_types.spec: bolt-on prop adapter, 4 x M3x4 SHCS into the motor bell, pilot on the shaft
M6x1 nut and washer clamp the prop hub on the adapter post (field joint)

edges.notes: adapter pilot bore (4 mm x 8.5 mm) on the shaft stub, base flat on the bell top, four M3x4 on the 12 mm circle (vendor fit list names the X3108S KV900); bench joint, never a field joint

joint_stack.fastener: M3x4 SHCS (4 supplied with the adapter)
joint_stack.hole: counterbored clearance in the adapter base; M3 tapped in the bell top by the maker
joint_stack.min_engagement_basis: deviation D-58 (a) from the 1.0 d rule (D-41), granted on CL-E1-ADAPTER-STRIP (RF 1.70 at 2.0 mm vs the 0.5 N m preload) and conditional on T-E1-MOTOR-RM measuring >= 2.5 mm of bell-top thread (CL-E1-ADAPTER-THREAD-D58); if the bell has >= 3.0 mm of thread and >= 4.0 mm free depth, M3x5 (3.5 mm, no deviation, CL-E1-ADAPTER-M3X5-ENGAGE) replaces it (CR-A4-43); tip >= 0.5 mm short of the windings
joint_stack.torque: 0.5 N m + Loctite 243 on the tip threads (C6; vendor value wins if printed)
joint_stack.access: from the front (-x), prop and nut off

retention.load_n: prop torque 0.33 N m at full throttle on a 6 mm radius = 14 N per screw in shear; thrust 16 N / 4 = 4 N axial; preload 0.5 N m / (0.2 x 3 mm) = 0.83 kN
retention.inspection: witness mark on each head; checked at every field set-up

edges.notes: 11x5.5MRP (LP11055MRP) on a LH post; LPAR06E ring centres the 1/4 in bore on the M6 post; hub rear face on the adapter shoulder; prop off for transport (pouch spanner, D-40)

joint_stack.fastener: M6x1 hex nut ISO 4032 (LH, steel, from the adapter set) + M6 washer 6 x 12 x 1.0
joint_stack.hole: 6.35 mm prop bore with LPAR06E ring to 6 mm
joint_stack.min_engagement_basis: full ISO 4032 nut height (nut strength >= the post); post tip at least flush with the nut face (CL-E1-NUT-ENGAGE); a 1.6 mm washer fails this
joint_stack.washer_nut: M6 washer 1.0 mm under the nut
joint_stack.torque: 1.5 N m, bell held by hand (C6 CR-C6-05, T-C6-PROPNUT)
joint_stack.tool: 10 mm spanner (the one field tool, box pouch)
